notes: A third query set over a fifth corpus and a language none of the first four cover. axios, cobra, click and okhttp are JavaScript, Go, Python and Kotlin/Java; clap is Rust, whose paths (crate::module::Type::method) and snake_case method names exercise identifier decomposition differently from every corpus already in the suite. All six queries were written against the source at the pinned revision and frozen before any tokenizer code was written; none was selected, worded or re-worded by looking at what a candidate implementation retrieves. Grades are the same scale the other two sets use. Truth is partial everywhere except the negative query, so precision and nDCG stay withheld.

queries.query: What rejects a command line that supplies two options which are not allowed together, and where is that mutual exclusion recorded?

ArgGroup records which arguments are mutually exclusive (multiple/required at :8)
asserts the declared conflict ids exist on the command
